Garage description
A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
The paint appeared on April 15th, 2020.
The paint could have been obtained by completing a special mission "Unlikely Hero" from the "Kill the Virus" event, which was to kill the player wearing the Virus paint in matchmaking battles within 12 hrs.
